notes.title: Update V0.6.2
notes.content:
1.	Added unlockable akimbo crossbows.
2.	Improved cutting mechanics.
3.	Added 2 new achievements.
4.	Minigame levels increased to 30.
5.	Throwing physics improved.
6.	Updated bHaptics plugin to latest version.
7.	Many small fixes and improvements. 
8.	Game menu pausing restored.
9.	Weapon grab animations and positions fixed.
10.	Leaderboard fixed.

notes.title: Update v0.5.6
notes.content:
Update v0.5.6

Fixed many issues that were reported last and this week.
Game is now ready for next content update - Sandbox !

Know issues : No input on some systems after application loads.
Fix : Launch SteamVR [b]FIRST[/b] and launch application within SteamVR.

Please report and leave feedback on Steam boards and official Discord.

Happy gaming !
